name: Ano Akari no Mukou ni
source:
The main character, Masumi, had lost his memory of the past in an accident.

I went to "Kosho Village" where my grandfather Kiyoteru lived for about ten years,
The girl I met there, Hazuki.
His encounter with her brings Masumi's past back to a little.

What happened on that lost summer festival?

A sad summer story. 


--
